description: Gate 4 positive controls (U8, KTD19): Stryker mutants of the scopes, named by global id. In every determinism profile each must be killed with an assertion by exactly its expected killers, and every listed covering non-killer must run with it and pass. Regenerate with `reselect` when a control or test goes missing (tools/mutation/controls/run-controls.ts).
reselect: npm run test:mutation:controls -- --select --work <dir outside the checkout>
